title: Test drive confirmation
description: Confirm a car test drive on WhatsApp with model, date, time and what to bring. Utility template for dealerships that reduces no-shows.
notes: Tell the customer to bring a driver license; practical instruction supports the utility category.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your test drive of the *{{model}}* is confirmed for {{date}} at {{time}}. Please bring your driver license. {{salesperson}} will meet you at the showroom.
